"""Scratch mutation checks; edits disposable bundle copies only."""
import hashlib,json,shutil,subprocess,sys,tempfile,time
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/workspace/tiny_village');BUNDLE=ROOT/'docs/planning/issue-734'
CASES=[('pristine',None),('changed_ledger','ledger.md'),('changed_publication_review','publication-review.md'),('changed_audit_report','audit-report.md'),('changed_capture_stdout','evidence/captures/child-4kz9nh_s/stdout.log'),('changed_capture_stderr','evidence/captures/child-4kz9nh_s/stderr.log'),('missing_artifact','ledger.md'),('missing_manifest_entry','audit-report.md'),('unlisted_artifact','unlisted-review.md'),('wrong_digest','audit-report.md'),('missing_manifest',None)]
rows=[]
for name,relative in CASES:
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='issue734-manifest-') as directory:
  fixture=Path(directory)/'repo';fixture.mkdir();(fixture/'.git').symlink_to(ROOT/'.git',target_is_directory=True)
  copied=fixture/'docs/planning/issue-734';shutil.copytree(BUNDLE,copied,ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('__pycache__'))
  if name.startswith('changed_'):
   with (copied/relative).open('ab') as stream:stream.write(b'\nIntegrity mutation probe\n')
  elif name=='missing_artifact':(copied/relative).unlink()
  elif name in ['missing_manifest_entry','wrong_digest']:
   p=copied/'artifact-hashes.json';d=json.loads(p.read_text())
   if name=='missing_manifest_entry':del d[relative]
   else:d[relative]='0'*64
   p.write_text(json.dumps(d,indent=2)+'\n')
  elif name=='unlisted_artifact':(copied/relative).write_text('Unlisted review artifact\n')
  elif name=='missing_manifest':(copied/'artifact-hashes.json').unlink()
  command=[sys.executable,str(copied/'validate_bundle.py')];start=time.monotonic()
  r=subprocess.run(command,cwd=fixture,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=25)
  rows.append({'scenario':name,'mutated_relative_path':relative,'expected_returncode':'zero' if name=='pristine' else 'nonzero','actual_returncode':r.returncode,'expectation_met':r.returncode==0 if name=='pristine' else r.returncode!=0,'elapsed_seconds':round(time.monotonic()-start,4),'stdout':r.stdout,'stderr':r.stderr})
result={'review_url':'https://github.com/dhar174/tiny_village/pull/797#discussion_r4342402200','validator_sha256':hashlib.sha256((BUNDLE/'validate_bundle.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'command':'python /workspace/scratch/issue-734/verify_manifest_review.py','fixture_policy':'Disposable complete bundle copy; original Git object database read via .git symlink; no network writes or original artifact mutations','parent_timeout_seconds':25,'scenarios':rows,'expectations_met':sum(r['expectation_met'] for r in rows),'scenario_count':len(rows)}
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps({'scenario_count':len(rows),'expectations_met':result['expectations_met'],'mutations_accepted':sum(r['actual_returncode']==0 for r in rows if r['scenario']!='pristine')},indent=2))
